```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'AED'
),
captures as (
    select o.channel,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'captured'
      and s.country_code = 'AE'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-07-01' and date '2026-07-31'
),
captured_by_channel as (
    select c.channel,
           sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as captured_amount
    from captures c
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
    group by c.channel
),
refunded_by_channel as (
    select o.channel,
           sum(rf.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as refunded_amount
    from refunds rf
    join orders o on o.order_id = rf.order_id
    join payment_attempts a on a.attempt_id = rf.attempt_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join fx on fx.currency = rf.currency and fx.rate_date = rf.business_date
    where not o.is_test
      and not a.is_test
      and rf.status = 'processed'
      and s.country_code = 'AE'
      and rf.business_date between date '2026-07-01' and date '2026-07-31'
    group by o.channel
)
select coalesce(c.channel, r.channel) as key,
       cast(round(coalesce(c.captured_amount, 0) - coalesce(r.refunded_amount, 0)) as bigint) as value
from captured_by_channel c
full outer join refunded_by_channel r on r.channel = c.channel
order by value desc, key asc
```
